item.title: Apple unveils Siri powered by Gemini, attempting a counterattack with an ‘AI agent’ (애플, 제미나이 입힌 시리 공개…‘AI 에이전트’로 반격 시도)
item.description:
Apple, which has been criticized as lagging behind competitors in the artificial intelligence (AI) field, has unveiled a new voice assistant, ‘Siri AI,’ based on Google’s Gemini. (인공지능(AI) 분야에서 경쟁사에 뒤처졌다는 평가를 받은 애플이 구글 제미나이 기반의 새 음성비서 ‘시리 에이아이’를 공개했다.)

At its annual Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) held at Apple headquarters in Cupertino, California on the 8th (local time), Apple announced the new Siri, stating, “We have collaborated with Google to create the next-generation Apple Foundation Model.” During a demonstration that day, when a photo of Santa Cruz Beach in California was displayed, Siri accurately identified the shooting location, found a friend’s address from a message, and even provided directions. This showcased an ‘AI agent’ capability that autonomously performs goals when a user gives a specific task. (애플은 8일(현지시각) 미국 캘리포니아주 애플 본사에서 연례 세계개발자회의(WWDC)를 열어 “구글과 협력해 차세대 애플 파운데이션 모델을 만들었다”며 새로운 시리를 발표했다. 애플은 이날 시연에서 미국 캘리포니아주 산타크루즈 해변 사진을 띄우자, 시리가 정확한 촬영 장소를 파악했고 메시지에 있던 친구 주소를 찾아내 길 안내까지 제공했다. 사용자가 특정 작업을 지시하면 자율적으로 목표를 수행하는 ‘인공지능 에이전트(대리인)’ 기능을 선보인 것이다.)

Users can also enjoy services like registering concert schedules in a calendar upon searching, or providing a reservation number from a booking email during a flight change process. Visual intelligence features have been enhanced as well, such as showing nutritional information when a camera is pointed at food, or calculating how much each person needs to pay when a receipt is photographed. (공연 일정을 검색하면 캘린더에 일정을 등록해주거나, 항공권 변경 과정에서 예약 이메일에 있던 예약번호를 제공하는 등의 서비스도 누릴 수 있다. 카메라로 음식을 비추면 영양 정보를 보여주고, 영수증을 찍으면 각자 얼마씩 계산해야 하는지 금액도 계산해주는 등 시각 지능 기능도 강화됐다.)

Apple highlighted privacy features as a differentiator for its AI capabilities. The company explained that despite incorporating generative AI services from external providers, data is processed through a combination of on-device and Apple’s own cloud methods, preventing external leaks. Craig Federighi, Senior Vice President of Software Engineering, emphasized, “Through on-device AI and a private cloud, we’ve blocked anyone, including Apple, from accessing or storing user data. AI privacy is a value that can never be compromised.” Previously, Apple had faced criticism for not demonstrating innovation in the AI competition compared to rivals like Microsoft or Google. (애플은 에이아이 기능의 차별점으로 보안 기능을 내세웠다. 외부 업체의 생성형 인공지능 서비스를 도입했지만, 데이터를 온디바이스 형태와 자체 클라우드를 병행해 처리하기 때문에 외부에 유출되지 않는다는 게 회사 쪽 설명이다. 크레이그 페더리기 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 수석부사장은 “단말형 인공지능과 비공개 클라우드를 통해 애플을 포함해 누구도 사용자 데이터에 접근하거나 이를 저장할 수 없도록 차단했다”며 “인공지능 프라이버시는 결코 타협할 수 없는 가치”라고 강조했다. 앞서 애플은 경쟁사인 마이크로소프트(MS)나 구글보다 인공지능 경쟁에서 혁신을 보여주지 못한다는 비판을 받아왔다.)

However, some assessments suggest that the features unveiled this time are not new but merely align with what Apple had previously previewed. Bloomberg pointed out, “This is just offering features that were planned for release in early 2025.” Apple’s stock closed at $301.54, down 1.89% from the previous trading day. (다만 한편에서는 이번에 선보인 기능이 새로운 내용이 아니라 그동안 애플이 예고했던 수준에 그친다는 평가도 나온다. 블룸버그는 “2025년 초에 출시할 예정이던 기능을 제공하는 것에 불과하다”고 지적했다. 애플 주가는 전 거래일보다 1.89% 내린 301.54 달러에 마감했다.)

Meanwhile, this year’s WWDC was the final appearance of CEO Tim Cook, who will step down as board chairman in September. The features announced by Apple will be available to developers starting today in the operating system beta, but will be released to general users as a beta version from next month. (한편 이날 세계개발자회의는 오는 9월 이사회 의장으로 물러나는 팀 쿡 최고경영자가 마지막으로 나선 자리였다. 애플이 공개한 기능들은 이날부터 개발자용 운영체제로 사용할 수 있지만, 일반 사용자들에게 다음 달부터 베타 버전으로 공개될 예정이다.)

Reporter Bae Ji-hyun beep@hani.co.kr (배지현 기자 beep@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Samsung Group to Introduce ChatGPT, Gemini in All Affiliates' Work Starting This Month (삼성그룹, 이달부터 전 관계사 업무에 챗GPT·제미나이 도입)
item.description:
Samsung Group has become the first among the top four conglomerates in South Korea to fully adopt external generative artificial intelligence (AI) services, such as ChatGPT, for the work of all employees across its affiliates. Previously, such use was banned due to security concerns, but the group has changed its policy to drive an 'AI transformation'. Whether Samsung's decision, as the nation's top conglomerate, will spread across the industry is drawing attention. (삼성그룹이 국내 4대 그룹 중 최초로 전체 그룹사 임직원들의 업무에 챗지피티(GPT) 등 외부 생성형 인공지능(AI)을 전면 도입한다. 지금까지는 보안 우려 등으로 이를 금지했지만, 그룹의 ‘인공지능 전환’을 위해 방침을 바꾼 것이다. 재계 1위 삼성의 결정이 업계 전반으로 퍼질지 주목된다.)

Samsung Group announced on the 9th that it will push for an "AI grand transformation" to fundamentally change work methods and organizational culture, including the full-scale adoption of AI across all operations of its affiliates. Earlier, exclusively reported that Samsung Electronics was considering fully allowing employees to use generative AI within the company. (, May 26, Page 19) ( 삼성그룹은 “관계사의 모든 업무에 인공지능을 전면 도입하는 등 일하는 방식과 조직 문화를 근본적으로 탈바꿈하는 ‘인공지능 대전환’을 추진할 것”이라고 9일 밝혔다. 앞서 <한겨레>는 삼성전자가 사내에서 직원들의 생성형 인공지능 사용을 전면 허용하는 방안을 추진한다고 단독 보도한 바 있다.(<한겨레> 5월26일치 19면))

Accordingly, all companies within the group, including Samsung Electronics, plan to fully introduce external generative AI services such as OpenAI's ChatGPT, Google's Gemini, and Anthropic's Claude this month. This means that each company will sign contracts for multiple enterprise AI services and allow employees to use them for free. The group's core division, Samsung Electronics' Device Solutions (DS) unit, will also permit all employees, except those handling confidential information, to use external AI models. ( 이에 따라 삼성전자 등 그룹 내 모든 회사가 이달 중 오픈에이아이의 챗지피티, 구글 제미나이, 앤트로픽 클로드 등 외부 생성형 인공지능 서비스를 전면 도입할 예정이다. 사별로 복수의 기업용 인공지능 서비스 이용 계약을 맺고 직원들이 이를 무상으로 사용할 수 있도록 하겠다는 것이다. 그룹의 핵심인 삼성전자 반도체(DS) 부문도 기밀 정보를 취급하는 인력을 제외한 모든 임직원이 외부 인공지능 모델을 쓸 수 있도록 허용할 방침이다.)

A dedicated AI organization will be established within every affiliate. This organization will develop AI transformation strategies tailored to each company's characteristics and be responsible for building security systems to prevent internal information leaks. About 50 top executives across Samsung Group will jointly declare an AI transformation vision this month. Samsung Group explains that the executives will lead management innovation through the AI grand transformation. ( 모든 그룹사에 인공지능 전담 조직도 만든다. 이 조직은 각사 특성에 맞는 인공지능 전환 추진 전략을 세우고, 내부 정보 유출 방지 등 보안 체계 구축 역할을 담당할 예정이다. 삼성그룹 내 전체 사장단 50여명은 이달 중 인공지능 전환 비전도 공동으로 선포한다. 사장단이 인공지능 대전환을 통한 경영 혁신을 주도한다는 것이 삼성그룹 쪽 설명이다.)

This measure reflects the intent to fully apply AI across all business operations of affiliates, using it as a driving force for innovation, given that AI has become an unstoppable trend. Earlier this year, Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong emphasized in a video New Year's address during a group executive seminar, "We must fundamentally change work methods and organizational DNA," adding, "AI must be integrated into all value chains, from R&D to production, marketing, and support." ( 이번 조처는 인공지능이 거스를 수 없는 대세가 되고 있는 만큼, 그룹사의 모든 업무에 이를 전면 적용해 혁신의 동력으로 삼겠다는 취지다. 이재용 삼성전자 회장도 앞서 올해 초 그룹 임원 대상 세미나에서 영상 신년사를 통해 “일하는 방식과 조직 디엔에이(DNA)를 송두리째 바꿔야 한다”며 “연구개발(R&D)부터 생산·마케팅·지원 등 모든 업무 밸류 체인에 인공지능을 접목해야 한다”고 강조한 바 있다.)

This marks the first time among the four major domestic conglomerates—Samsung, SK, Hyundai Motor, and LG—that a group-level policy for full external AI model use and support has been established. At Hyundai Motor, employees can only access ChatGPT and Gemini through an in-house AI-based work support service called 'H Chat,' which has reinforced security; individual employees cannot directly access external AI models via company computers. SK and LG groups also have no unified policy, with each company either supporting external AI model use on its own or restricting access via company computers. ( 삼성·에스케이(SK)·현대차·엘지(LG) 등 국내 4대 그룹 가운데 그룹 차원의 외부 인공지능 모델 전면 사용 및 지원 방침을 마련한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 현대차의 경우 보안을 강화한 자체 인공지능 기반 업무 지원 서비스인 ‘에이치(H) 챗’을 통해서만 챗지피티, 제미나이 등을 끌어와서 사용할 수 있고, 직원이 개인적으로 회사 컴퓨터를 통해 외부 인공지능 모델에 접속하는 건 불가능하다. 에스케이와 엘지그룹도 그룹 내 통일된 방침 없이 각 사가 자체적으로 외부 인공지능 모델 이용을 지원하거나, 회사 컴퓨터를 통한 접속을 제한하고 있다.)

By Park Jong-oh, Reporter pjo2@hani.co.kr ( 박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Not Exchanging to Won'... Companies Piling Up Dollars Earned from Exports in Bank Accounts, Government Policies Also Ineffective (‘환전 안 할래’…수출로 번 달러 통장에 쌓는 기업들, 정부 정책도 역부족)
item.description:
Recently, dollars earned from exports, especially semiconductors, are either remaining in overseas accounts or, even when brought into the country, are piling up without being converted into Korean won. This is interpreted as companies delaying conversion to won due to strong expectations of a further rise in the exchange rate. As the dollar-won exchange rate, which has breached 1,500 won, persists for over three weeks, the government is preparing countermeasures, including again asking companies to exchange their dollars. (최근 반도체를 중심으로 수출로 벌어들인 달러가 국외 계좌에 머물거나 국내로 들어온 달러도 원화로 환전되지 않은 채 쌓여가고 있다. 환율 상승 기대가 강해 원화로 환전을 미루고 있는 것으로 풀이된다. 1500원을 뚫은 원-달러 환율이 3주 이상 지속하자 정부가 다시 기업들에 환전을 요청하는 등 대응책을 마련 중이다.)

According to the banking sector on the 9th, the total corporate dollar deposits at five banks—KB Kookmin, Shinhan, Hana, Woori, and NH Nonghyup—stood at $52.442 billion (approximately 80.4985 trillion won) as of the 5th. Compared to the end of last month, this increased by $1.022 billion (approximately 1.5688 trillion won) in just four business days, and by $5.832 billion (approximately 8.9521 trillion won) from the end of March. (9일 은행권에 따르면, 케이비(KB)국민·신한·하나·우리·엔에이치(NH)농협 등 5개 은행의 법인 달러 예금 잔액은 지난 5일 기준 524억4200만달러(80조4985억원)로 집계됐다. 지난달 말과 비교해 4영업일 만에 10억2200만달러(1조5688억원)가 늘었고, 3월 말보다는 58억3200만달러(8조9521억원) 증가했다.)

This appears to be because export companies are holding onto the dollars received as export proceeds without converting them into won. It is said that they either expect exchange rate gains from further appreciation of the dollar or are preparing for future dollar-denominated payment needs. A banking sector official said, "As exchange rate volatility increases, there is a lot of demand to hold onto dollars as they are." (이는 수출기업들이 수출대금으로 받은 달러를 원화로 환전하지 않고 그대로 보유하고 있기 때문으로 보인다. 환율 추가 상승에 따른 환차익을 기대하거나 향후 달러 결제 수요에 대비하려는 목적도 있다고 한다. 은행권 관계자는 “환율 변동성이 커지다 보니 달러를 그대로 보유하려는 수요가 많다”고 말했다.)

This is not limited to the dollar holdings accumulated domestically. According to the Bank of Korea, the increase in dollars (cash and deposits) accumulated by domestic banks (depository institutions) in overseas accounts also recorded an all-time high of $12.16 billion (approximately 18.6656 trillion won) in April compared to the previous month. A Bank of Korea official stated, "Due to the strong export performance of domestic companies, cash and deposits in overseas accounts have increased significantly." The dollars earned from exports are not sufficiently flowing into the domestic foreign exchange market and being converted into won, limiting the exchange rate stabilization effect despite the export boom. (국내에 쌓인 달러보유액뿐만 아니다. 한국은행에 따르면, 국내 은행(예금취급기관)이 국외 계좌에 쌓아둔 달러 현금·예금의 증가폭도 지난 4월 기준 전월 대비 121억6천만달러(18조6656억원)로 역대 최대치를 기록했다. 한국은행 관계자는 “국내 기업들의 수출 호조로 국외 계좌 현금·예금이 큰 폭으로 증가했다”고 밝혔다. 수출로 벌어들인 달러가 국내 외환시장에 충분히 유입돼 원화로 환전되지 않으면서 수출 호조에도 환율 안정 효과가 제한되고 있는 것이다.)

The Ministry of Economy and Finance plans to hold a meeting with export companies and foreign exchange market participants on the 11th. It is expected that measures to improve the supply and demand of foreign currency, such as the conversion of export proceeds into won, will be discussed. The ministry previously requested cooperation from export companies like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to stabilize the exchange rate in November and December last year when the exchange rate exceeded the mid-1,400 won range. The Financial Supervisory Service also plans to hold meetings by sector, starting with the banking sector on the 9th, and then securities and insurance, to review responses to the high exchange rate. (재정경제부는 오는 11일 수출기업과 외환시장 관련 간담회를 열 계획이다. 수출대금의 원화 환전 등 외환 수급 개선을 위한 방안이 논의될 것으로 보인다. 재경부는 지난해 11·12월에도 환율이 1400원 중반대를 웃돌자 삼성전자, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 등 수출기업에 환율 안정 협조를 요청한 바 있다. 금융감독원도 9일 은행권을 시작으로 증권·보험 등 업권별 간담회를 열고 고환율 대응 방안을 점검한다.)

Meanwhile, the Ministry of Economy and Finance held a meeting with foreign exchange market experts on the same day to review the market situation. The ministry reported that participants expressed the view that the recent one-sided trend in the foreign exchange market is temporary and that volatility will ease in the future, citing factors such as the upward revision of the first-quarter GDP preliminary figures, the continued current account surplus, and the operation of the National Pension Service's new framework. (한편 재경부는 이날 외환시장 전문가 간담회를 열고 시장 상황을 점검했다. 재경부는 참석자들이 1분기 국내총생산(GDP) 잠정치 상향, 경상수지 흑자 지속, 국민연금 뉴프레임워크 가동 등을 근거로 최근 외환시장의 쏠림 현상이 일시적이며 향후 변동성도 완화될 것이라는 견해를 보였다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Korea Federation of Textile Industries, Byun Young-man Takes Office as Executive Vice Chairman (한국섬유산업연합회, 변영만 상근부회장 취임)
item.description:
The Korea Federation of Textile Industries (Chairman Choi Byung-oh, hereinafter referred to as “KOFOTI”) announced on June 9 (Tuesday) that it appointed Byun Young-man, former Policy Planning Officer of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, as its Executive Vice Chairman during the ‘26th Second Board of Directors meeting. (한국섬유산업연합회(회장 최병오, 이하 “섬산련”)는 6월 9일(화) 개최된 ‘26년 제2차 이사회에서 변영만 前산업통상자원부 정책기획관을 상근 부회장으로 선임했다고 밝혔다.)

Byun Young-man, the new Executive Vice Chairman, graduated from Yonsei University’s Department of Public Administration, completed a Master’s in Business Administration at San Francisco State University in the U.S., and finished doctoral coursework in Business Administration at Soongsil University. He passed the 35th Higher Civil Service Examination and has served as Director of the Investment Policy Division (Deputy Director-General) at the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Director-General of the Technical Regulations Response Bureau at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, Policy Advisor to the Minister, Policy Planning Officer, and Executive Vice Chairman of the Korea Iron & Steel Association. <<> Based on his extensive administrative experience in the government’s industrial policies, technical regulation responses, investment, and planning, along with his understanding of the industry, he is expected to play a key role in revitalizing and strengthening the competitiveness of Korea’s textile and fashion industry. <<> In his inaugural remarks, Executive Vice Chairman Byun Young-man stated, “I feel a great sense of responsibility as I take on the important role of Executive Vice Chairman of KOFOTI,” and added, “I will leverage my 30 years of experience at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy to do my utmost for the strengthening of competitiveness in the textile and fashion industry and for sustainable development.” <<> Executive Vice Chairman Byun Young-man took office on June 15, with a term of three years. <<> <This article is a news piece provided by the Korea Federation of Textile Industries and may differ from the opinions of The Hankyoreh> (변영만 신임 상근부회장은 연세대학교 행정학과를 졸업, 美 샌프란시스코주립대 경영학 석사, 숭실대학교 경영학 박사과정을 수료하였으며, 행정고시 35회를 거쳐, 지식경제부 투자정책과장(부이사관), 산업통상자원부 기술규제대응국장, 장관정책보좌관, 정책기획관, 한국철강협회 상근부회장 등을 역임했다.)

item.title: Chairman Choi Byung-oh of KOFOTI Tours France, Italy, and Belgium in Europe, Responds to EU Regulations and Expands Global Cooperation for K-Fashion (최병오 섬산련 회장, 프랑스·이탈리아·벨기에 유럽 3개국 순방, EU 규제 대응 및 K-패션 글로벌 협력 확대 나서)
item.description:
Chairman Choi Byung-oh of the Korea Federation of Textile Industries (KOFOTI, Chairman Choi Byung-oh, hereinafter KOFOTI) will visit three European countries—France, Italy, and Belgium—from Wednesday, June 10 to Monday, June 15, holding a series of meetings with major textile and fashion-related organizations to expand K-textile and fashion's entry into the European market and strengthen industrial cooperation. (한국섬유산업연합회(회장 최병오, 이하 섬산련) 최병오 회장은 오는 6.10일(수)부터 15일(월)까지 프랑스, 이탈리아, 벨기에 등 유럽 3개국을 방문해 주요 섬유패션 유관기관과 연쇄 회동을 갖고, K-섬유패션의 유럽시장 진출 확대와 산업 협력 강화에 나선다.)

As his first schedule, Chairman Choi will meet with the heads of three major organizations representing the French textile and fashion industry on June 11 in Paris, France: Chairman Olivier Ducatillon of the Union des Industries Textiles (UIT), Chairman Pierre-François Le Louët of the Union Française des Industries de la Mode et de l'Habillement (UFIMH), and Chairman Yann Rivoallan of the Fédération Française du Prêt-à-porter Féminin (FFPAPF). (최 회장은 첫 일정으로 6월 11일 프랑스 파리에서 프랑스 섬유산업연합회(UIT) 올리비에 듀카틸롱(Oliviere Ducatillon) 회장, 프랑스 의류패션산업연합회(UFIMH) 피에르 프랑스와 르 루에(Pierre-François Le Louët) 회장, 프랑스 여성기성복연합회(FFPAPF) 얀 리보알랑(Yann Rivoallan) 회장 등 프랑스 섬유패션업계를 대표하는 3대 단체장을 접견한다.)

This meeting will focus on discussing ways to expand cooperation between the two countries' industries on key tasks that will determine the future competitiveness of the textile and fashion industry, such as sustainability (CSR), digital transformation (DX), and industrial innovation. (이번 면담에서는 지속가능성(CSR), 디지털 전환(DX), 산업혁신 등 섬유패션산업의 미래 경쟁력을 좌우할 핵심 과제를 중심으로 양국 업계 간 협력 확대 방안을 논의할 예정이다.)

Since signing a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the French Union des Industries Textiles (UIT) in November 2023, KOFOTI has been continuing cooperation to respond to changes in the global supply chain, including the Digital Product Passport (DPP) and the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR). (섬산련은 지난 2023년 11월 프랑스 섬유산업연합회(UIT)와 업무협약(MOU)을 체결한 이후, 디지털제품여권(DPP), 에코디자인 규제(ESPR) 등 글로벌 공급망 변화에 대응하기 위한 협력을 지속해 오고 있다.)

On June 12, Chairman Choi will attend a business meeting held in Rome, Italy, along with CEO Choi Hye-won of Hyungji I&C, and hold talks with Vice Chairman Silvana Pezzoli of Confindustria Moda, a long-time partner of KOFOTI. (이어 6월 12일에는 이탈리아 로마에서 개최되는 기업간담회에 형지I&C 최혜원 대표와 함께 참석하고, 섬산련의 오랜 파트너인 ‘이탈리아 섬유패션산업연합회(Confindustria Moda)’ 실바나 페졸리(Silvana Pezzoli) 부회장과 면담을 갖는다.)

Both sides will discuss ways to enhance the competitiveness of the textile and fashion industries of both countries, including expanding cooperation in high-end fashion sourcing, fostering high value-added manufacturing bases, and building a sustainable fashion supply chain. (양측은 하이엔드 패션소싱 협력 확대와 고부가가치 제조기반 육성, 지속가능한 패션 공급망 구축 등 양국 섬유패션산업의 경쟁력 제고 방안을 논의할 예정이다.)

KOFOTI signed an MOU with Italy's Confindustria Moda in 2007, and the Italian side contributes to expanding exchange in the fashion industries of both countries by holding the Italian Fashion Days in Korea in Seoul every year. (섬산련은 지난 2007년 이탈리아 섬유패션산업연합회(Confindustria Moda)와 MOU를 체결한 바 있으며, 이탈리아측은 매년 서울에서 이탈리아 패션 트레이드쇼(Italian Fashion Days in Korea)를 개최하는 등 양국 패션산업 교류 확대에 기여하고 있다.)

As the final schedule of the tour, Chairman Choi will visit Brussels, Belgium, from June 13 to 14, meeting with Secretary General Dirk Vantyghem of the European Apparel and Textile Confederation (EURATEX) and Director Pol Lombaert of Centexbel, the EU's Joint Research Centre (JRC) for ESPR (Ecodesign Regulation). (순방 마지막 일정으로 최 회장은 6월 13일부터 14일까지 벨기에 브뤼셀을 방문해 EU섬유패션연합회(EURATEX) 더크 벤티겜(Dirk Vantyghem) 사무총장과 EU측 ESPR(에코디자인 규제) 공동연구센터(JRC)인 센텍스벨(Centexbel)의 폴 롬바르트(Pol Lombaert) 사무국장과 면담한다.)

At this meeting, they will review the implementation progress of the ESPR textile preparatory study under the EU's strongly promoted 'Sustainable Textile Strategy,' discuss EU trends on the forced labor ban law and supply chain transparency policy, which domestic industries are closely watching, as well as EU trade policy and Korea-EU textile manufacturing expansion strategies. (이 자리에서 유럽연합(EU)이 강력하게 추진 중인 ‘지속가능한 섬유전략’의 ESPR 섬유 준비연구 등 이행 경과를 파악하고, 국내 업계가 주시하고 있는 강제노동 금지법, 공급망 투명성 정책 등에 대한 EU측 동향과 함께 EU측 통상정책과 한·EU 섬유제조 확대전략 등을 논의할 예정이다.)

A KOFOTI official stated, "The EU is the fourth-largest export market for Korea's textile and fashion industry after Vietnam, China, and the United States, and a key partner in the fashion industry, with exports of K-fashion products to Italy, in particular, steadily increasing," adding, "We expect that this tour of France, Italy, and Belgium will serve as an opportunity to accelerate K-fashion's entry into the European market while substantially enhancing the cooperative relationship between Korea and Europe." (섬산련 관계자는 “EU는 베트남, 중국, 미국에 이어 우리나라 섬유패션산업의 제4위 수출시장이자 패션산업 핵심 파트너로, 특히 이탈리아의 경우 K-패션제품의 수출이 꾸준히 늘고 있다”면서, “이번 프랑스·이탈리아·벨기에 순방은 K-패션의 유럽시장 진출을 가속화하는 동시에, 한국과 유럽간 협력 관계를 본격적으로 제고할 수 있는 계기가 마련될 것으로 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

(<이 기사는 한국섬유산업연합회에서 제공한 정보기사로, 한겨레의 의견과 다를 수 있습니다>)

item.title: Kyung Hee University College of Fine Arts Hosts "First Steps" Exhibition (경희대 미술대학, 첫걸음 展 개최)
item.description:
Kyung Hee University (President Kim Jin-sang) College of Fine Arts has opened the "2026 First Steps Exhibition" to commemorate the 60th anniversary of the College of Fine Arts, and held a special event inviting members and parents. This exhibition is designed as a platform to share the first artistic works of incoming freshmen with the university community. (경희대학교(총장 김진상) 미술대학이 미술대학 개교 60주년을 기념해 ‘2026 미술대학 첫걸음 展’을 개막하고 구성원과 학부모를 초청하는 특별 행사를 개최했다. 이번 전시는 신입생들의 첫 작품 세계를 학내 구성원과 공유하는 자리로 마련됐다.)

The exhibition has been organized with the purpose of displaying the early works created by freshmen admitted to the College of Fine Arts, supporting their artistic growth. Space designs utilizing the freshman character "Mirangi" and participatory installation works have been incorporated to enhance the visitor experience. The exhibition runs throughout the entire museum from the 1st to the 4th floor, and is operated to allow free viewing by members and visitors during the event period. (이번 전시는 미술대학에 입학한 신입생들이 창작한 초기 작품을 전시해 예술적 성장을 응원하는 취지로 마련됐다. 신입생 캐릭터 ‘미랑이’를 활용한 공간 디자인과 참여형 설치 작품이 구성돼 관람객의 체험 요소를 강화했다. 전시는 미술관 1층부터 4층까지 전관에서 진행되며, 행사 기간 동안 구성원과 방문객이 자유롭게 관람할 수 있도록 운영된다.)

On Monday, June 8, an opening event was held on the 1st floor of the art museum. Faculty members of the College of Fine Arts, parents, current students, and university staff attended to celebrate the freshmen's artistic world together. The event introduced a parent invitation program, providing time to directly present the College of Fine Arts' curriculum and creative environment. (6월 8일(월) 오후에는 미술관 1층에서 오프닝 행사를 열었다. 미술대학 교수진, 학부모, 재학생, 교내 구성원 등이 참석해 신입생의 작품 세계를 함께 축하했다. 행사에는 학부모 초청 프로그램을 도입해 미술대학의 교육 과정과 창작 환경을 직접 소개하는 시간도 마련했다.)

The exhibition runs from Monday, June 8 to Thursday, June 14 at the College of Fine Arts Museum KUMA, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. The College of Fine Arts operates this exhibition in connection with educational programs aimed at helping freshmen adapt academically and expand their creative activities. Support was provided to enhance practical creative capabilities through counseling on the artwork production process and feedback programs with supervising professors. (전시는 6월 8일(월)부터 14일(목)까지 미술대학 미술관 KUMA에서 오전 9시부터 오후 6시까지 진행된다. 미술대학은 이번 전시를 신입생의 학업 적응과 창작 활동 확장을 위한 교육 프로그램과 연계해 운영한다. 작품 제작 과정에 대한 상담과 지도교수 피드백 프로그램을 통해 실질적 창작 역량을 높이도록 지원했다.)

Dean of the College of Fine Arts, Na Hyung-min, stated, "The 'First Steps Exhibition' is an exhibition that supports the beginning of freshmen at the College of Fine Arts as they grow into artists. It holds great significance as the first exhibition in celebration of the 60th anniversary of the College of Fine Arts, allowing not only members but also parents to participate together," and added, "The process of presenting works to the world for the first time is a very important experience for students. This should be seen as an extension of education that supports students' creative will and artistic growth," clarifying the meaning of this exhibition. <<> <This article is a news piece provided by the university and may differ from the opinions of The Hankyoreh> (미술대학은 나형민 학장은 “첫걸음 展은 예술가로 성장해 가는 미술대학 신입생들의 시작을 응원하는 전시회다. 미술대학 60주년을 맞아 구성원뿐만 아니라 학부모까지 함께 참여할 수 있는 첫 전시로 의미가 크다”라면서 “처음 작품을 세상에 내놓는 과정은 학생들에게 매우 중요한 경험이다. 학생들의 창작 의지를 응원하고 예술적 성장을 지원하는 교육의 연장선으로 봐야 한다”라며 이번 전시의 의미를 밝혔다.)

item.title: Hanyang University’s Future Innovative Tourism Research Lab Wins ‘Best Paper Award’ at 2026 APacCHRIE Conference (한양대 미래혁신관광연구실, 2026 아태 호텔·관광학회(APacCHRIE) ‘최우수 논문상’ 수상)
item.description:
The Future Innovative Tourism Research Lab at Hanyang University (led by Professor Shin Hak-seung) won the Best Paper Award for Industry Practice at the prestigious 2026 APacCHRIE Conference, held from May 28 to 31 in Osaka, Japan. (한양대학교 미래혁신관광연구실(지도교수 신학승)이 지난 5월 28일부터 31일까지 일본 오사카에서 개최된 세계적 권위의 학술대회 ‘2026 아태 호텔·관광학회(APacCHRIE Conference)’에서 최우수 논문상(Best Paper Award for Industry Practice)을 수상했다.)

APacCHRIE (Asia-Pacific Council on Hotel, Restaurant, and Institutional Education) is the most authoritative academic organization in the hotel and tourism field, with over 75 universities from 18 countries in the Asia-Pacific region as members. At this conference, more than 700 researchers participated and presented 450 academic papers. The research paper by the Hanyang University Future Innovative Tourism Research Lab team, led by Professor Shin Hak-seung, received the Best Paper Award for its achievement in connecting practical issues in the tourism and hospitality industry with academic analysis. (APacCHRIE(Asia-Pacific Council on Hotel, Restaurant, and Institutional Education)는 아시아·태평양 지역 18개국, 75개 이상의 대학이 회원으로 참여하는 호텔·관광 분야 최고 권위의 학술단체다. 이번 학회에는 약 700명 이상의 연구자가 참여하여 450편의 학술논문을 발표했으며, 신학승 교수가 이끄는 한양대 미래혁신관광연구실 연구진의 논문은 관광·호스피탈리티 산업 현장의 실무적 쟁점과 학술적 분석을 연결한 성과를 인정받아 최우수 논문상을 수상했다.)

The award-winning paper, co-authored by researchers Jo Ji-hyun and Kwon Hyun-ji along with Professor Shin Hak-seung, is titled "Career Plateau and Divergent Turnover Pathways: Organizational Context in the Airline Industry." The research team sharply analyzed the problem of workforce outflow in the tourism and hospitality industry, which has worsened since COVID-19, within the context of the airline industry. In particular, the study attracted attention by identifying the process through which career stagnation (e.g., limited promotions, lack of growth opportunities) experienced by airline employees leads to multifaceted turnover intentions, and by comparatively analyzing this process differentially based on the organizational contexts of Full-Service Carriers (FSC) and Low-Cost Carriers (LCC). (수상의 영예를 안은 논문은 조지현·권현지 연구원과 신학승 교수가 공동 집필한 「Career Plateau and Divergent Turnover Pathways: Organizational Context in the Airline Industry」이다. 연구진은 코로나19 이후 더욱 심화된 관광·호스피탈리티 산업의 인력 유출 문제를 항공산업 맥락에서 날카롭게 분석했다. 특히 항공사 종사자가 겪는 경력정체(승진 제한, 성장 기회 부족 등)가 다면적인 이직 의도로 이어지는 과정을 규명하고, 이를 대형항공사(FSC)와 저비용항공사(LCC)의 조직 맥락에 따라 차별적으로 비교 분석해 주목을 받았다.)

Through in-depth interviews, the research team revealed that employees’ decisions to leave go beyond simple resignation intentions, involving highly complex pathways such as "movement within the same industry," "transition to other tourism sectors," and "departure from the industry." Additionally, they derived insights that a low turnover rate does not necessarily indicate high job satisfaction, and that careful attention must be paid to employees’ psychological disengagement. This evaluation suggests the research presents a new direction for workforce management in the tourism industry, moving beyond conventional measures to reduce turnover rates and requiring consideration of employees’ career prospects and job quality. (연구진은 심층 인터뷰를 통해 종사자의 이직 판단이 단순한 퇴사 의향을 넘어 ‘동일 산업 내 이동’, ‘타 관광 분야 전환’, ‘산업 이탈’ 등 매우 복잡한 경로를 거친다는 점을 밝혀냈다. 또한, 낮은 이직률이 반드시 높은 직무 만족을 의미하지는 않으며, 종사자의 심리적 이탈까지 세심히 살펴야 한다는 시사점을 도출했다. 이는 기존의 단순 이직률 저감 대책을 넘어 종사자의 경력 전망과 일자리의 질을 함께 고민해야 한다는 관광산업 인력 관리의 새로운 방향성을 제시했다는 평가다.)

Professor Shin Hak-seung, the supervising professor, stated, "At a time when AI, digital transformation, and sustainability demands are converging, tourism is being reexamined as a field that newly connects regions, industries, and individual lives." He added, "Going forward, we will continue to explore the expanded role of tourism and conduct meaningful research that can practically contribute to the sustainable development of regions and industries." (지도교수인 신학승 교수는 “AI와 디지털 전환, 지속가능성 요구가 맞물리는 지금, 관광은 지역과 산업, 개인의 삶을 새롭게 연결하는 영역으로 재조명되고 있다”며, “앞으로도 관광의 확장된 역할을 탐구하며 지역과 산업의 지속가능한 발전에 실질적으로 기여할 수 있는 의미 있는 연구를 이어가겠다”고 말했다.)

Lead author Researcher Jo Ji-hyun expressed, "This is a study examining the overall sustainability of the tourism and hospitality industry through the career issues of airline industry workers." She added, "For the tourism industry to grow sustainably, we must innovate not only the experiences of tourists but also the career experiences of workers and the quality of jobs." (주저자로 참여한 조지현 연구원은 “항공산업 종사자의 경력 문제를 통해 관광·호스피탈리티 산업 전반의 지속가능성을 살펴본 연구”라며, “관광 산업이 지속가능하게 성장하기 위해서는 관광객의 경험뿐만 아니라 종사자들의 경력 경험과 일자리의 질을 함께 혁신해야 한다”고 소감을 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, at this conference, the Future Innovative Tourism Research Lab presented various research findings for sustainable tourism in addition to the award-winning work. Researchers Kwon Na-hyun and Jo Yu-jeong discussed practical strategies for sustainable tourism under the theme of "high-involvement pro-environmental behavior," and Researcher Kwak Ji-won presented research findings on "tourist participation in ESG activities," receiving a positive response. The lab plans to continue international research that analyzes social and industrial challenges from a tourism perspective, focusing on core research areas such as regional tourism development, sustainability, ESG, and digital transformation. (한편, 미래혁신관광연구실은 이번 학회에서 수상작 외에도 지속가능한 관광을 위한 다양한 연구 성과를 선보였다. 권나현·조유정 연구원은 ‘고관여 친환경 행동’을 주제로 지속가능한 관광 실천 방안을 논의했으며, 곽지원 연구원은 ‘관광객의 ESG 활동 참여’에 관한 연구 성과를 발표해 큰 호응을 얻었다. 연구실은 앞으로도 지역관광개발, 지속가능성, ESG, 디지털 전환을 핵심 연구 분야로 삼아 사회적·산업적 과제를 관광학 관점에서 분석하는 국제적 연구를 이어갈 예정이다.)

item.title: Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies Appoints Creator Song Chae-rin as Global Ambassador to Promote Programs such as Korean-Russian Legal Interpreting Course (사이버한국외국어대학교, 크리에이터 송채린 글로벌 홍보대사 위촉…한-러 사법통역사과정 특화 프로그램 등 홍보 맞손)
item.description:
Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (President Moon Hwi-chang) announced on June 4 (Thursday) that it has appointed Korean language education content creator Song Chae-rin (known by the alias ‘Cherish’) as a Global Ambassador at the university’s Cyber Building. (사이버한국외국어대학교(총장 문휘창)는 6월 4일(목) 대학 사이버관에서 한국어교육 콘텐츠 크리에이터 송채린(활동명 ‘채리쉬’)을 글로벌 홍보대사(CUFS Global Ambassador)로 위촉했다고 밝혔다.)

The appointment of this global ambassador by Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies was pursued to strengthen communication with Koryo-saram residing in Korea and overseas learners from Russian-speaking countries such as Russia, Uzbekistan, and Kazakhstan, as well as to promote the university’s online higher education and Korean language education capabilities internationally. Ambassador Song Chae-rin is expected to cooperate in various global promotional activities of the university until June 2027. (사이버한국외대의 이번 글로벌 홍보대사 위촉은 국내 거주 고려인과 러시아, 우즈베키스탄, 카자흐스탄 등 러시아어권 해외 학습자와의 소통을 강화하고 온라인 고등교육과 한국어교육 역량을 국제적으로 알리기 위해 추진됐다. 송채린 홍보대사는 2027년 6월까지 대학의 다양한 글로벌 홍보 활동에 협력할 예정이다.)

Ambassador Song Chae-rin is a content creator and influencer who has been engaged in Korean language education activities for learners in Russia and the CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States). Based on her major in Russian language and her experience in Korean language education accumulated both domestically and internationally, she has operated an online Korean language education platform since 2021. Additionally, she communicates with approximately 800,000 online learners through her YouTube channel Cherish (@teacherCherish), which has 369,000 subscribers, and social media platforms such as Instagram. She has also participated in the production and promotion of Korea-related content in collaboration with public institutions such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Health and Welfare. (송채린 홍보대사는 러시아 및CIS(독립국가연합) 학습자 대상 한국어교육 활동을 이어 온 콘텐츠 창작자이자 인플루언서이다. 러시아어 전공과 국내외 현장에서 쌓아온 한국어교육 경험을 바탕으로 2021년부터 운영한 온라인 한국어교육 플랫폼은 물론, 구독자 36만 9천 명을 보유한 유튜브 채널 채리쉬(@teacherCherish)와 인스타그램 등 소셜미디어를 통해 약 80만 명의 온라인 학습자와 소통하고 있다. 이와 함께 외교부, 보건복지부와 같은 공공기관과 협력해 한국 관련 콘텐츠 제작 및 홍보 활동에도 참여한 바 있다.)

The Global Education Center of Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies will engage in university promotional activities targeting Russian-speaking and Koryo-saram learners alongside Ambassador Song. In particular, the university plans to focus on introducing its specialized educational programs, including the Korean-Russian Legal Interpreting Course Microdegree, which will be launched starting in the fall semester, as well as Korean language education, foreign language and interpretation/translation programs, to overseas learners. (사이버한국외국어대학교 글로벌교육원은 송 홍보대사와 함께 러시아어권 및 고려인 학습자를 대상으로 하는 대학 홍보 활동에 나선다. 특히 오는 가을학기서부터 개설되는 한-러 사법통역사과정 마이크로디그리를 비롯해 한국어교육, 외국어·통번역 등 대학의 특화 교육과정을 해외 학습자에게 소개하는 데 주력할 방침이다.)

President Moon Hwi-chang of Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies stated, “Ambassador Song Chae-rin is a person who has conveyed the Korean language and culture to overseas learners in their own language and perspective,” adding, “I hope that through this appointment, Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies’ online higher education capabilities and Korean language education content can reach more global learners.” (문휘창 사이버한국외대 총장은 “송채린 홍보대사는 한국어와 한국문화를 해외 학습자의 언어와 감각으로 전달해 온 인물”이라며 “이번 위촉을 계기로 사이버한국외대의 온라인 고등교육 역량과 한국어교육 콘텐츠가 더 많은 글로벌 학습자에게 닿을 수 있기를 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies is accepting applications for new and transfer students for the second semester of the 2026 academic year until July 16 (Thursday). The university selects students from 10 departments, including ▲Department of English Studies ▲Department of Chinese Studies ▲Department of Japanese Studies ▲Department of Korean Studies ▲Department of Spanish Studies ▲Department of Vietnamese and Indonesian Studies ▲Department of Business Administration ▲Department of Industrial Safety and Housing Management ▲Department of Counseling Psychology ▲Department of K-Beauty Studies. Anyone with a high school diploma or higher is eligible to apply for regular bachelor’s degree programs and part-time non-degree programs, regardless of nationality or place of residence. Detailed information about admissions can be found at the Admissions Support Center (go.cufs.ac.kr), and individual consultations are also available by phone (02-2173-2580), email (ipsi@cufs.ac.kr), and KakaoTalk (cufs). (한편 사이버한국외국어대학교는 7월 16일(목)까지 2026학년도 2학기 신·편입생을 모집한다. ▲영어학부 ▲중국어학부 ▲일본어학부 ▲한국어학부 ▲스페인어학부 ▲베트남·인도네시아학부 ▲경영학부 ▲산업안전·주택관리학부 ▲상담심리학부 ▲K뷰티학부 등 10개 학부에서 학생을 선발하며, 고등학교 졸업 이상의 학력이 있다면 국적이나 거주지에 관계없이 누구나 정규 학사학위 과정과 시간제 비학위 과정에 지원이 가능하다. 입학에 관한 자세한 사항은 입학지원센터(go.cufs.ac.kr)에서 확인할 수 있으며, 전화(02-2173-2580)와 이메일(ipsi@cufs.ac.kr), 카카오톡(cufs)으로 개별 상담 또한 제공한다.)

item.title: Professor Park Hoon of the University of Seoul Appointed to the 7th Term of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission Advisory Committee (서울시립대 박훈 교수, 국민권익위원회 제7기 국민권익자문위원 위촉)
item.description:
Professor Park Hoon of the Department of Taxation at the University of Seoul (President Won Yong-geol) has been appointed as a member of the 7th Term of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission Advisory Committee. The appointment term is two years, from June 5, 2026, to June 4, 2028. (서울시립대학교(총장 원용걸) 세무학과 박훈 교수가 국민권익위원회 제7기 국민권익자문위원으로 위촉됐다. 위촉기간은 2026년 6월 5일부터 2028년 6월 4일까지 2년이다.)

The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission Advisory Committee is a body established under the "Act on the Prevention of Corruption and the Establishment and Operation of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission" to advise on major policies, current issues, and mid- to long-term development directions of the commission. The 7th Term Advisory Committee consists of 44 experts from various sectors of society, including academia, legal circles, civil society, and youth representatives. (국민권익자문위원회는 「부패방지 및 국민권익위원회의 설치와 운영에 관한 법률」에 근거해 국민권익위원회의 주요 정책과 현안, 중장기 발전방향 등에 대해 자문하는 기구이다. 제7기 국민권익자문위원회는 학계·법조계·시민사회·청년 등 사회 각계의 다양한 전문가 44명으로 구성됐다.)

Professor Park Hoon is an expert who has accumulated research and practical experience in the fields of tax law, taxpayer rights protection, and improvement of tax administration and tax systems. He graduated from Seoul National University's College of Law and earned both a master's and doctoral degree in law from the same university. As a professor in the Department of Taxation at the University of Seoul, he has contributed to tax law education and research, as well as the training of tax professionals. (박훈 교수는 조세법, 납세자 권익 보호, 세무행정 및 조세제도 개선 분야에서 연구와 실무 경험을 축적해 온 전문가이다. 서울대학교 법과대학을 졸업하고 같은 대학에서 법학석사 및 법학박사 학위를 취득했으며, 서울시립대학교 세무학과 교수로 재직하면서 조세법 교육과 연구, 세무전문인력 양성에 기여하고 있다.)

Additionally, Professor Park served as a Taxpayer Advocate at the National Tax Service, working to protect taxpayer rights and enhance the fairness of tax administration. He has also actively participated in academic discussions on the development of tax law and institutional improvements through major academic organizations, such as serving as the president of the Korean Society of Tax Law. (또한 박 교수는 국세청 납세자보호관을 역임하며 납세자 권익 보호와 세무행정의 공정성 제고에 힘써 왔고, 한국세법학회장 등 주요 학술단체 활동을 통해 조세법 분야의 학문적 발전과 제도개선 논의에도 적극 참여해 왔다.)

Professor Park stated, "As a member of the Advisory Committee, I will strive to contribute to enhancing the objectivity and effectiveness of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission's policies based on my research and experience accumulated in tax law and taxpayer rights protection." (박 교수는 “국민권익자문위원으로서 조세법과 납세자 권익 보호 분야에서 쌓아온 연구와 경험을 바탕으로 국민권익위원회 정책의 객관성과 실효성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The University of Seoul evaluated this appointment as an example of the university's commitment to public service, expertise, and social responsibility. It is particularly significant that expertise in tax law and tax administration has contributed to national tasks such as protecting citizens' rights, preventing corruption, and providing remedies for rights infringements. (서울시립대학교는 이번 위촉이 대학의 공공성, 전문성, 사회적 책무를 보여주는 사례라고 평가했다. 특히 조세법과 세무행정 분야의 전문성이 국민 권익 보호, 부패방지, 권익구제 등 국가적 과제에 기여하게 됐다는 점에서 의미가 크다.)

item.title: Chung-Ang University's Virtual Convergence College and UT Dallas Co-Host Global Collegiate 'Overwatch' Esports Event (중앙대 가상융합대학, 미 UT Dallas와 ‘오버워치’ 글로벌 이스포츠 대학전 공동 개최)
item.description:
Chung-Ang University (President Park Se-hyun) announced that its Virtual Convergence College (Dean Wi Jung-hyun) held a global esports friendly match on June 3 with the University of Texas at Dallas (UT Dallas), a prestigious American university. (중앙대학교(총장 박세현) 가상융합대학(학장 위정현)이 지난 6월 3일 미국의 명문 대학인 텍사스 대학교 달라스 캠퍼스(University of Texas at Dallas, 이하 UT Dallas)와 글로벌 이스포츠 친선 경기를 개최했다고 밝혔다.)

This event was organized through the globally popular esports title 'Overwatch' to promote cultural and human exchange between the two universities, while also serving as part of a 'test-bed' for operating esports. The match was conducted in a collaborative format, utilizing UT Dallas's broadcast transmission technology and Chung-Ang University's Virtual Convergence College official YouTube channel and platform, and was streamed live in real time in both Korea and the United States. (이번 행사는 글로벌 인기 이스포츠 종목인 ‘오버워치(Overwatch)’를 통해 양국 대학 간의 인적·문화적 교류를 활성화하는 한편, 이스포츠 운영을 위한 '테스트베드(Test-bed)'의 일환으로 마련됐다. 매치는 UT Dallas 측의 방송 송출 기술과 중앙대학교 가상융합대학의 공식 유튜브 채널 및 플랫폼 협업 형태로 진행되어, 한국 및 미국에서 실시간으로 생중계됐다.)

The friendly match held special significance as it marked the first official international activity for the 'Chung-Ang Esports Players' previously selected by the Virtual Convergence College. The intercollegiate competition was a best-of-three series, and the Chung-Ang University Esports Players lost with a set score of 0-2. While UT Dallas, composed of top-ranked North American collegiate players who had trained for over a year, was an elite team, Chung-Ang's team, a multidisciplinary group of students from various majors, competed after only a short practice period, earning praise for their strong performance. In the subsequent mixed match between the two schools, a 'Korea-U.S. mixed team' was formed by randomly matching players from both sides. They recorded a 1-1 draw over two games, creating a space for harmony and friendship beyond the win-loss outcome. (특히 이번 친선전은 중앙대 가상융합대학이 앞서 선발한 ‘중앙대 이스포츠 플레이어’의 첫 번째 공식 글로벌 활동이라는 점에서 의미를 더했다. 양국 대학 간의 대항전은 3판 2선승제로 진행되었으며, 중앙대 이스포츠 플레이어들은 세트 스코어 0대 2로 패했다. UT Dallas는 북미 대학 상위 랭커들로 구성되어 1년 이상 훈련해 정예 팀인 반면, 중앙대 팀은 다양한 전공의 학생들이 모인 다학제 융합 팀으로 단기간 연습을 거쳐 출전했다는 점을 고려하면 선전했다는 평가다. 이어 진행된 양교 혼합 매치에서는 양교 선수들을 무작위 추첨으로 매칭한 ‘한·미 혼합팀’을 구성, 총 2게임 동안 1대 1 무승부를 기록하며 승패를 넘어선 화합과 우정의 장을 만들어냈다.)

A representative student player from Chung-Ang University shared, "Just being able to play directly against the top-ranked players from a North American university was a truly enjoyable and valuable experience." They added, "Regardless of the outcome, communicating with American university student players, forming teams together, and enjoying the game helped me understand the meaning of global exchange." Additionally, UT Dallas students showed particular interest in the cooperative play style of the Chung-Ang students, which differed from their own. (경기에 참여한 중앙대 이스포츠 플레이어 대표 학생은 “북미 대학의 최상위 랭커들과 직접 게임할 수 있었던 것 자체만으로도 정말 즐겁고 소중한 경험이었다”라며, “승패를 떠나 미국 현지 대학생 선수들과 소통하고 함께 팀을 이뤄 게임을 즐기며 글로벌 교류의 의미를 알게 됐다”고 소감을 전했다. 또한 UT Dallas 학생들은 게임 방식이 그들과 다른 중앙대 학생들과의 협동 플레이에 각별한 관심을 표시하기도 했다.)

Dean Wi Jung-hyun of the Virtual Convergence College stated, "Esports holds the potential to be a representative immersive media content." He commented, "This friendly match achieved successful results in building a test-bed for operating esports competitions and served as a meaningful stepping stone to strengthen the global exchange environment between the universities of both countries." He added, "Starting with the activities of these esports players, we will work to further expand human exchange with leading international universities, including UT Dallas, and strive to build infrastructure and develop educational programs to lead global virtual convergence education." (위정현 가상융합대학장은 “이스포츠는 대표적인 실감미디어 콘텐츠의 가능성을 지니고 있다”며, “이번 친선전은 이스포츠 경기 운영을 위한 성공적인 테스트베드 구축 성과를 거두고, 양국 대학 간의 글로벌 교류 환경을 다지는 뜻깊은 발판이 되었다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “이번 이스포츠 플레이어들의 활동을 시작으로 UT Dallas를 비롯한 해외 유수 대학과의 인적 교류를 더욱 확대하고, 글로벌 가상융합 교육을 선도할 수 있도록 인프라 구축과 교육 프로그램 마련을 위해 노력하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Chung-Ang University's Virtual Convergence College continues to pursue platform-based educational innovation that transcends boundaries between universities and countries, accelerating the cultivation of talent to lead the future virtual convergence industry. (중앙대 가상융합대학은 대학 간, 국가 간 경계를 허무는 플랫폼 기반 교육 혁신을 지속하고 있으며, 미래 가상융합 산업을 선도할 인재 배출에 박차를 가하고 있다.)

item.title: Soongsil University Awards Honorary Doctorates to FEBC Chairman Kim Jang-hwan and Nepes Chairman Lee Byung-gu (숭실대, 극동방송 김장환 이사장·네패스 이병구 회장 명예박사 학위 수여)
item.description:
Soongsil University (President Lee Yoon-jae) announced on June 5 at 10:30 a.m. in the Hyeongnam Hall on campus that it awarded an Honorary Doctorate in Business Administration to Kim Jang-hwan, Chairman of Far East Broadcasting Company (FEBC), and an Honorary Doctorate in Engineering to Lee Byung-gu, Chairman of Nepes Co., Ltd. (숭실대학교(총장 이윤재)는 6월 5일 오전 10시 30분 교내 형남홀에서 극동방송 김장환 이사장에게 명예경영학박사 학위를, 주식회사 네패스 이병구 회장에게 명예공학박사 학위를 각각 수여했다고 밝혔다.)

The degree ceremony was attended by Oh Jung-hyun, Chairman of the School Foundation Soongsil University Board of Trustees, President Lee Yoon-jae, other key university officials, as well as representatives and family members from FEBC and Nepes. The conferral of these honorary doctorates was determined by comprehensively considering achievements in respective fields, social contributions, and the realization of Soongsil University's educational philosophy of 'Truth and Service.' (이날 학위수여식에는 오정현 학교법인 숭실대 이사장과 이윤재 총장을 비롯한 주요 보직자, 극동방송 및 네패스 관계자와 가족 등이 참석했다. 이번 명예박사 학위 수여는 각 분야에서의 공적과 사회적 기여, 그리고 숭실대의 교육 이념인 '진리와 봉사' 실천 성과를 종합적으로 고려해 결정됐다.)

Kim Jang-hwan, who received the Honorary Doctorate in Business Administration, is a figure who has contributed to broadcast ministry and the development of media. Chairman Kim led the overall management in growing FEBC into a leading domestic religious broadcaster and served as President of the Baptist World Alliance (BWA) from 2000 to 2005. Through this, he contributed to enhancing the international stature of Korean Protestantism and promoting human rights and freedom. Additionally, his continuous practice of relief and sharing activities led him to be evaluated as someone who has embodied Soongsil's founding philosophy of 'Truth and Service,' resulting in this degree conferral. (명예경영학박사 학위를 받은 김장환 이사장은 방송 선교와 언론 미디어 발전에 기여해 온 인물이다. 김 이사장은 극동방송을 국내 대표 종교 방송사로 성장시키는 과정에서 경영 전반을 이끌었으며, 2000년부터 2005년까지 세계침례교연맹(BWA) 총회장을 역임했다. 이를 통해 한국 개신교의 국제적 위상 제고와 인권·자유 증진 활동에 기여해 왔다. 아울러 지속적인 구호와 나눔 활동을 실천해 온 점에서 숭실대의 건학 이념인 '진리와 봉사'를 구현해 온 인물로 평가돼 이번 학위 수여가 이뤄졌다.)

Lee Byung-gu, who received the Honorary Doctorate in Engineering, is an entrepreneur who pioneered the semiconductor back-end process industry. Since establishing Nepes in 1990, Chairman Lee has consistently invested in research and development and pursued technological innovation, contributing to strengthening the competitiveness of the domestic semiconductor industry. In particular, his contribution to advancing the industrial ecosystem through the development of advanced packaging technology was recognized. Furthermore, his leadership in improving organizational culture and labor-management relations based on 'gratitude management' and 'human-respect management,' along with his contribution to realizing corporate social value, were reflected as the background for the degree conferral. (명예공학박사 학위를 받은 이병구 회장은 반도체 후공정 산업을 개척한 기업인이다. 이 회장은 1990년 네패스 설립 이후 연구개발 투자와 기술 혁신을 지속하며 국내 반도체 산업 경쟁력 강화에 기여해 왔다. 특히 첨단 패키징 기술 발전을 통해 산업 생태계 고도화에 기여한 점이 인정됐다. 또한 '감사 경영'과 '인간 존중 경영'을 바탕으로 조직 문화와 노사 관계 개선을 이끌며 기업의 사회적 가치 실현에도 기여해 온 점이 학위 수여 배경으로 반영됐다.)

Oh Jung-hyun, Chairman of the School Foundation Board of Trustees, stated, "This degree conferral is a ceremony to honor the accumulated achievements and social contributions in each field," adding, "I expect it will serve as an opportunity to spread the university's ideals and values." (오정현 학교법인 이사장은 "이번 학위 수여는 각 분야에서 축적된 성과와 사회적 기여를 기리는 자리"라며 "대학의 이념과 가치를 확산하는 계기가 될 것으로 기대한다"고 밝혔다.)

President Lee Yoon-jae said, "Welcoming Chairman Kim Jang-hwan and Chairman Lee Byung-gu as Soongsil alumni is a meaningful event," adding, "The dedication and accomplishments shown by these two individuals align with the values the university pursues and will serve as important role models for our members." (이윤재 총장은 "김장환 이사장과 이병구 회장을 숭실의 동문으로 맞이하게 된 것은 의미 있는 일"이라며 "두 인물이 보여준 헌신과 성과는 대학이 지향하는 가치와 맞닿아 있으며 구성원들에게 중요한 귀감이 될 것"이라고 말했다.)

Chairman Kim Jang-hwan said, "I deeply appreciate receiving an honorary degree from Soongsil University," adding, "I will continue to fulfill my role for society and the next generation." Chairman Lee Byung-gu said, "I consider it an honor to receive a doctorate in engineering from the university," adding, "I will contribute to industry and society through technology-based growth." (김장환 이사장은 "숭실대학교에서 명예학위를 받게 된 것을 뜻깊게 생각한다"며 "앞으로도 사회와 다음 세대를 위한 역할을 이어가겠다"고 했다. 이병구 회장은 "대학에서 공학박사 학위를 받게 된 것을 영예로 생각한다"며 "기술 기반 성장을 통해 산업과 사회에 기여하겠다"고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, Soongsil University, established in 1897 as the first modern university in Korea, plans to expand collaboration with various sectors of society by strengthening its educational and research capabilities ahead of its 130th anniversary next year. (한편 숭실대는 1897년 설립된 국내 최초의 근대 대학으로, 내년 130주년을 앞두고 교육·연구 역량 강화를 통해 사회 각 분야와의 협력을 확대해 나갈 계획이다.)

item.title: Kookmin University HUSS Global Coexistence Project Team Hosts '2026 Global Coexistence Joint Academic Festival' (국민대 HUSS 글로벌공생사업단, ‘2026 글로벌공생 연합학술제’ 개최)
item.description:
On May 29, the HUSS Global Coexistence Project Team at Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol) held the finals for the 3rd '2026 Global Coexistence Joint Academic Festival' in Room 301 of the Management Building on campus. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) HUSS 글로벌공생사업단은 지난 5월 29일 교내 경영관 301호에서 제3회 ‘2026 글로벌공생 연합학술제’ 본선을 개최했다.)

This event was a joint academic festival involving the five participating universities (Kwangwoon University, Kookmin University, Sun Moon University, Yeungnam University, and Honam University) of the HUSS Global Coexistence Consortium, supported by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea, and was organized by Kookmin University's Global Coexistence Project Team. This year's academic festival, under the theme 'Proposing Multidisciplinary Problem-Solving Ideas for Global Sustainable Coexistence and Growth,' was conducted from March 30 to May 29, divided into preliminary rounds and finals. (이번 행사는 교육부와 한국연구재단이 지원하는 HUSS 글로벌공생컨소시엄의 5개 참여대학(광운대, 국민대, 선문대, 영남대, 호남대)이 함께한 연합 학술 행사로, 국민대 글로벌공생사업단이 주관했다. 올해 학술제는 ‘글로벌 지속가능 공생 및 성장을 위한 다학제적 문제 해결 아이디어 제안’을 주제로 3월 30일부터 5월 29일까지 예선과 본선으로 나뉘어 진행됐다.)

The academic festival was designed to analyze complex issues facing global society—such as the climate crisis, social inequality, demographic changes, cultural conflicts, and ethical issues arising from technological advancement—from the perspective of university students, and to seek solutions through interdisciplinary collaboration based on diverse academic knowledge. (학술제는 기후위기, 사회적 불평등, 인구 구조 변화, 문화 갈등, 기술 발전에 따른 윤리 문제 등 글로벌 사회가 직면한 복합적 문제를 대학생의 시각에서 분석하고, 다양한 전공 지식을 바탕으로 전공 간 협업을 통해 해결 방안을 모색하기 위해 마련됐다.)

Nine teams that advanced to the finals presented ideas across various fields, including sustainability, technology, welfare, culture, language, and urban issues. Each team explained their problem awareness, solutions, and expected outcomes through presentations and Q&A sessions. The judges comprehensively evaluated topic suitability, creativity, multidisciplinary approach, feasibility, and presentation skills. The finals were judged by Professor Ahn Hyun-chul (School of Management Information Systems), Professor Thompson Ephraim Kwasi (KIBS), and Professor Joo Song-ha (Department of Political Science and International Relations). (본선에 오른 9개 팀은 지속가능성, 기술, 복지, 문화, 언어, 도시 문제 등 다양한 분야의 아이디어를 발표했다. 각 팀은 발표와 질의응답을 통해 문제의식, 해결 방안, 기대 효과를 설명했으며, 심사위원들은 주제 적합성, 창의성, 다학제적 접근, 실행 가능성, 발표 역량 등을 종합적으로 평가했다. 본선 심사는 안현철 교수(경영정보학부), 톰슨 에브라임 과시 교수(KIBS), 주송하 교수(정치외교학과)가 맡았다.)

The Grand Prize was awarded to the 'MediBridge' team from Yeungnam University, which proposed a 'Cultural Idiom-Based Symptom Translation and Hospital Matching Solution' to improve medical accessibility for international students. The Best Excellence Award went to the 'Sipsiilbap' team from Kookmin University, which presented the 'Make One Extra Portion' campaign for underprivileged youth. Excellence Awards were given to the 'CitySeed' joint team from Kwangwoon University and Sun Moon University for proposing an AI-based citizen-participatory carbon behavior transition platform using living-area energy data, the 'Gwiyeopjo' team from Kookmin University for presenting an AI-based user-customized, accessibility-focused cultural tourism integrated platform, and the 'Solocare' team from Kookmin University for proposing an AI-based monitoring system to prevent solitary deaths among single-person households. Other finalist teams were awarded the 'Global Coexistence Award.' (대상은 외국인 유학생의 의료 접근성 향상을 위한 ‘문화적 관용어 기반 증상 번역 및 병원 매칭 솔루션’을 제안한 영남대 ‘메디브릿지’ 팀이 수상했다. 최우수상은 취약계층 청소년을 위한 ‘1인분 더 만들기’ 캠페인을 발표한 국민대 ‘십시일밥’ 팀이 받았다. 우수상은 생활권 에너지 데이터를 활용한 AI 기반 시민 참여형 탄소행동 전환 플랫폼을 제안한 광운대·선문대 연합팀 ‘시티시드’, AI 기반 사용자 맞춤형 접근성 중심 문화관광 통합 플랫폼을 발표한 국민대 ‘귀엽조’ 팀, AI를 활용한 1인 가구 고독사 예방 모니터링 시스템을 제안한 국민대 ‘Solocare’ 팀이 각각 수상했다. 그 밖의 본선 진출팀에도 ‘글로벌공생상’이 수여됐다.)

Professor Ahn Hyun-chul from Kookmin University's Global Coexistence Project Team, who organized the event, stated, "This academic festival was a platform where students interpreted complex issues of global society based on their majors and areas of interest, and proposed solutions through multidisciplinary collaboration." He added, "We will continue to expand various programs so that students can experience the values of a sustainable future and global coexistence as they grow." (행사를 주관한 국민대 글로벌공생사업단 안현철 교수는 “이번 학술제는 학생들이 글로벌 사회의 복합적 문제를 자신의 전공과 관심 분야에 기반해 해석하고, 다학제적 협업을 통해 해결 방안을 제안해 본 자리였다”며 “앞으로도 학생들이 지속가능한 미래와 글로벌 공생의 가치를 체감하며 성장할 수 있도록 다양한 프로그램을 확대해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the HUSS Global Coexistence Consortium, supported by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea for three years starting in 2024, is jointly operated by Kwangwoon University, Kookmin University, Sun Moon University, Yeungnam University, and Honam University. The consortium aims to nurture 2,500 convergent talents equipped with sustainable resource responsiveness, sustainable industry understanding, and sustainable international community inclusivity, promoting various educational and international exchange programs. (한편 HUSS 글로벌공생컨소시엄은 2024년부터 3년간 교육부와 한국연구재단의 지원을 받아 광운대, 국민대, 선문대, 영남대, 호남대가 공동 운영하고 있다. 컨소시엄은 지속가능 자원 대응력, 지속가능 산업 이해력, 지속가능 국제사회 포용력을 갖춘 융합인재 2,500명 양성을 목표로 다양한 교육 및 국제교류 프로그램을 추진하고 있다.)

item.title: Private School Pension to Conduct '2026 Retirement Preparation Training' for Scheduled Retirees (사학연금, 퇴직 예정 교직원 대상 ‘2026년 퇴임대비 연수’ 실시)
item.description:
The Private School Teachers and Staff Pension Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the Private School Pension, Chairman Song Ha-jung) announced on the 8th that it will conduct the '2026 First Retirement Preparation Training' for 150 scheduled regular (honorary) retiring faculty and staff from June 8 to 10 at Maison Glad Jeju. (사립학교교직원연금공단(이하 사학연금, 이사장 송하중)은 6월 8일부터 10일까지 정년(명예)퇴직 예정 교직원 150명을 대상으로 메종글래드 제주에서 ‘2026년 제1차 퇴임대비 연수’를 실시한다고 8일 밝혔다.)

This training includes education on the Private School Pension system and welfare programs that faculty and staff must know before retirement, along with guidance on the Teachers' Mutual Aid Association and National Health Insurance system, special lectures on asset management and tax-saving strategies, and lectures on slow-aging health methods. It also includes social gatherings where participants can share know-how on preparing for retirement and post-retirement life. (이번 연수는 교직원들이 퇴직 전 꼭 알아야 할 사학연금제도, 복지사업 프로그램에 대한 교육과 더불어 교직원공제회 및 국민건강보험 제도 안내, 자산관리‧절세 특강, 저속노화 건강법 강의로 이루어지며, 노후 준비와 퇴직 후 생활에 대한 노하우 등을 함께 공유할 수 있는 친교의 시간도 마련되어 있다.)

Chairman Song Ha-jung stated, "I hope this training provides a valuable time for faculty and staff facing the third act of life to systematically prepare for a comfortable and happy retirement." (송하중 이사장은 “이번 연수를 통해 인생 3막을 앞둔 교직원이 편안하고 행복한 노후생활을 체계적으로 준비할 수 있도록 유익한 정보를 얻을 수 있는 시간이 되기를 바란다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Private School Pension's 2026 Retirement Preparation Training will be conducted a total of four times—twice in Jeju Island and twice in Seoul—targeting approximately 660 people. For faculty and staff unable to attend in person, regional retirement preparation briefings and online education through the integrated welfare platform (welfare.tp.or.kr) will also be provided. (한편, 사학연금 2026년 퇴임대비 연수는 약 660명을 대상으로 제주도와 서울에서 각 2회씩 총 4회 실시되며, 연수 참석이 어려운 교직원을 위해 지역별 퇴임대비 설명회와 공단 통합복지플랫폼(welfare.tp.or.kr)을 통한 온라인 교육도 제공될 예정이다.)

item.title: “Institutional Investors Must Also Consider ESG Factors When Engaging with Companies”… Amended Stewardship Code (“기관투자자가 기업에 관여할 때 ESG 요소도 고려”…스튜어드십 코드 개정안)
item.description:
<<>> A public hearing has been held on amendments aimed at transforming the stewardship code (principles for institutional investors’ fiduciary duties), which has been operated in a perfunctory manner, into a substantive responsible investment norm befitting the era of the KOSPI index at 8,000. <<> The Korea ESG Standards Institute (hereinafter KESGI) and the Korea Exchange held a related public hearing on the 8th at the Korea Exchange Conference Hall in Yeouido, Seoul. KESGI will collect public opinions until the 26th of this month, and then finalize the amendment by synthesizing the expert opinions presented on this day. <<> The stewardship code is a principle that institutional investors, like faithful stewards managing client funds, should responsibly exercise voting rights and actively engage to enhance the value of invested companies and shareholder interests. Unlike legalized norms such as the Commercial Act and the Capital Markets Act, it is considered a soft law because institutional investors can autonomously decide whether to join the code and implement it flexibly. <<> Since its enactment at the end of 2016, the domestic stewardship code has not been amended once, and it has been criticized for being nominal due to the inadequate system for implementing and monitoring institutional investors’ engagement activities. However, as institutional investor engagement in the capital market is effective in improving the backward corporate governance structure, a major cause of the Korea Discount, the need to substantiate the implementation of the stewardship code has been consistently raised. President Lee Jae-myung promised to strengthen the stewardship code in his election pledges and national tasks. <<> The core of the amendment unveiled by KESGI on this day is not merely to broaden institutional investors' shareholder engagement but to redesign it around substance, accountability, and follow-up monitoring. Key contents include: △Allowing the scope of assets to which the stewardship code applies to be voluntarily expanded from existing domestic listed stocks to bonds, real estate, infrastructure, unlisted stocks, and overseas assets; △Explicitly listing environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors and sustainability as non-financial elements, linking them not just to ethical slogans but to the long-term value of investee companies for shareholder engagement activities; △Establishing a new provision enabling "collaborative engagement activities" where institutional investors join forces; △Broadening the scope of shareholder engagement beyond dialogue with companies and exercising voting rights to encompass overall investment decisions such as investment expansion or withdrawal; △Reflecting the amended Commercial Act's duty of loyalty to shareholders, requiring checks on whether the board of directors of investee companies diligently performs its duties for the company and shareholders; △Mandating institutional investors to prepare guidelines for fiduciary responsibility activities, enhancing accountability through engagement stages, escalation procedures, periodic reporting, and report submissions; △Requiring institutional investors to submit annual activity reports to KESGI for monitoring stewardship code implementation; △Strengthening the role of the Stewardship Code Development Committee to review the need for code amendments every three years and annually monitor the level of fiduciary responsibility implementation of participating institutions. <<> Experts who participated in the discussion on this day generally acknowledged that this amendment aligns with the direction of developing the stewardship code into an effective responsible investment norm, while pointing out omissions in the amendment process or potential issues that may arise during implementation. <<> Furthermore, the civic group Economic Reform Alliance (Director: Kim Woo-chan, Professor at Korea University) issued a commentary on the 9th, evaluating the amendment as "very insufficient as it lacks practical means to induce institutional investors to implement the stewardship code." Specifically, the amendment entrusts the monitoring of stewardship code implementation to the Stewardship Code Development Committee (hereinafter Development Committee), but a part-time private committee commissioned by KESGI is limited in checking the code implementation of 257 institutional investors. Even if KESGI, as the secretariat, supports the work, they have only two to three staff members handling related tasks, making it difficult to say they have sufficient support capabilities. Moreover, since KESGI conducts business with institutions, there are concerns about conflicts of interest even if a firewall is established. The Economic Reform Alliance suggested that the Financial Supervisory Service, which has adequate human and professional capabilities, would be a more realistic option. The alliance also pointed out that the amendment does not include provisions for disclosing monitoring results and does not explicitly grant the Development Committee the authority to exclude non-compliant institutions from code participation. <<> At the public hearing, concerns were raised about the uncertainty of the scope and potential for abuse of sustainability factors like ESG newly introduced. Professor Kim Jian of Pusan National University (Law School) pointed out, "It should be clearly stated that sustainability factors like ESG are not independent objectives but elements considered to the extent they affect the long-term interests of clients and fiduciaries and the long-term value of investment assets." He also proposed, as the UK did in its recent stewardship code revision, introducing the concept of 'systemic risk' affecting the market and financial system more broadly than ESG, allowing coverage of geopolitics, supply chains, artificial intelligence (AI), and cybersecurity. <<> Lee Chang-hwan, CEO of Align Partners, warned that expanding ESG could lead to 'ESG washing,' diluting governance issues. "The essence of the Korea Discount is not a lack of climate action or social contribution but a governance structure centered on controlling shareholders and a lack of shareholder returns," he said. "Treating ESG equally in guidelines risks giving a free pass to ESG washing, where controlling shareholders cause immense damage to ordinary shareholders through unfair mergers, only to argue that they have increased eco-friendly investments." <<> Opinions were also raised on the need to substantiate the reports that serve as the basis for monitoring implementation. The suggestion was to transform the implementation reports, which have been at the level of checklists for regulatory compliance, into reports centered on practice and explanation. Professor Lee Ji-yoon of Yonsei University (Business Administration) evaluated this amendment as strengthening transparency and accountability in institutional investors' judgment criteria and decision-making processes, stating, "This direction aligns with the fundamental purpose of the stewardship code and can ultimately lead to behavioral changes among institutional investors." <<> Lee Dong-seop, Head of Fiduciary Responsibility at the National Pension Service (NPS), stated that institutional investors' implementation reports "should focus on outcomes, describing how shareholder engagement activities have practically influenced corporate value enhancement and governance improvement." He also noted that because NPS entrusts half of its managed assets to external managers, the capacity of these entrusted managers is directly linked to NPS's overall stewardship code implementation capability. "NPS aims to check the stewardship code implementation level of entrusted asset managers and reflect the results more substantially in the evaluation and selection of entrusted managers," he said. <<> It was pointed out that a certain follow-up evaluation system is essential for reporting and monitoring to have practical significance. Professor Lee Ji-yoon noted, "In the UK, the content of published reports is evaluated, and institutions that fall short of standards lose their signatory (participant) status." She added, "In Korea, we could consider measures that, after a long period, review the participating institution's qualifications if it fails to faithfully fulfill its obligations or submits only formal reports with insufficient actual activity." <<> The need for supplementation to ensure genuine engagement activities align with the clarified duty of loyalty to shareholders following last year's Commercial Act amendment was also pointed out. CEO Lee Chang-hwan emphasized the importance of focusing monitoring on conflicts of interest between controlling and ordinary shareholders to clarify the abstract duty of loyalty. "It would be good to clearly establish as a core criterion for monitoring and engagement whether the board of directors has sufficiently considered the interests of all shareholders in situations of conflict, such as disposal of treasury shares, third-party allotment capital increases, mergers, tender offers, delistings, and dual listings," he said. The need for communication channels between institutional investors and boards of directors was also highlighted. Lawyer Sook-mi Lee (Shin & Kim) stated, "Most engagement activities have been practitioner-centered," and "We need to shift toward board-centered communication engagement, which could involve utilizing the compensation committee or ESG committee within the board." <<> The collaborative engagement activities reflected in this amendment were evaluated as significant. CEO Lee Chang-hwan said, "It is difficult for a single shareholder to engage effectively; multiple institutions raising a collective voice is key to the effectiveness of engagement, and the stewardship codes of major countries, including the UK, actively encourage this," expressing hope for conditions that enable such engagement activities to operate well. <<> A proposal was also made to link the stewardship code with the Value-Up Program to enhance effectiveness. This involves the Korea Exchange reflecting the evaluation of corporate value enhancement plans when selecting 10 companies annually. Cho Jin-woo, Head of the Corporate Value-Up Support Division at the Korea Exchange, stated, "Companies that actively respond to institutional investors' proactive engagement are more likely to have a genuine will for corporate value enhancement activities, so this could be included as a qualitative evaluation factor in selecting excellent Value-Up companies." <<> Text and photos by Lee Bong-hyun, Research Fellow at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute ESG Center bhlee@hani.co.kr ()
